versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Garmin Trail-Running Roadmap & Training Plan.
- Automates the creation of trail race roadmaps and dynamic training plans using Garmin activity data and GPX race tracks.
- Supports deep analysis of Garmin data, including heart rate zones and ascent calibration.
- Generates personalized training schedules that can be synced directly to macOS/iOS system calendars.
- Enables straightforward extraction of activity highlights for easy social media sharing.
